notes: The TFP410 datasheet does not document an OTP / fuse content. VEN_ID = 0x014C, DEV_ID = 0x0410, and REV_ID are hardwired (mask-ROM or metal-strap), not user-programmable. There is no user-programmable cryptographic key, calibration trim, or unique device serial number specified at the TFP410 silicon level. HDCP cryptographic keys are NOT inside TFP410 — HDCP cipher is system-level and assumed to be implemented in a separate device. Therefore this item is reported as NOT APPLICABLE at the TFP410 specification level.
